name: Mew
description: Apparently, it appears only to those people who are pure of heart and have a strong desire to see it.

moves.name: Pound
moves.description: The foe is physically pounded with a long tail or a foreleg, etc.

moves.name: Transform
moves.description: The user transforms into a copy of the foe right down to having the same move set.

moves.name: Mega Punch
moves.description: The foe is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.

moves.name: Metronome
moves.description: The user waggles a finger and stimulates the brain into randomly using nearly any move.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description: The foe is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Barrier
moves.description: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

moves.name: Amnesia
moves.description: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. It sharply raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Me First
moves.description: The user tries to cut ahead of the foe to steal and use the foe’s intended move with greater power.

moves.name: Baton Pass
moves.description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, passing along any stat changes.

moves.name: Nasty Plot
moves.description: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. It sharply raises the user’s Sp. Atk.

moves.name: Aura Sphere
moves.description: The user looses a blast of aura power from deep within its body. This move is certain to hit.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Cut
moves.description: The foe is cut with a scythe or a claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.

moves.name: Fly
moves.description: The user soars, then strikes on the second turn. It can also be used for flying to any familiar town.

moves.name: Roar
moves.description: The foe is scared off, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

moves.name: Flamethrower
moves.description: The foe is scorched with an intense blast of fire. The target may also be left with a burn.

moves.name: Surf
moves.description: It swamps the entire battlefield with a giant wave. It can also be used for crossing water.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.description: The foe is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. It may also freeze the target solid.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the foe. It may also freeze the target solid.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

moves.name: Strength
moves.description: The foe is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It can also be used to move boulders.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description: A strong electric blast is loosed at the foe. It may also leave the foe paralyzed.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: A weak electric charge is launched at the foe. It causes paralysis if it hits.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.description: The user sets off an earthquake that hits all the Pokémon in the battle.

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: The user burrows, then attacks on the second turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description: The foe is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from special attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Fire Blast
moves.description: The foe is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Waterfall
moves.description: The user charges at the foe rapidly, and may make it flinch. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.

moves.name: Dream Eater
moves.description: An attack that works only on a sleeping foe. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user’s HP.

moves.name: Flash
moves.description: The user flashes a light that cuts the foe’s accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.

moves.name: Explosion
moves.description: The user explodes to inflict damage on all Pokémon in battle. The user faints upon using this move.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.description: Large boulders are hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Thief
moves.description: The user attacks and steals the foe’s held item simultaneously. It can’t steal if the user holds an item.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Sludge Bomb
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling filthy sludge at the foe. It may also poison the target.

moves.name: Sandstorm
moves.description: A five-turn sand storm is summoned to hurt all combatant types except Rock,  Ground, and Steel.

moves.name: Giga Drain
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: False Swipe
moves.description: A restrained attack that prevents the foe from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.description: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Steel Wing
moves.description: The foe is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Return
moves.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

moves.name: Frustration
moves.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

moves.name: Safeguard
moves.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.

moves.name: Iron Tail
moves.description: The foe is slammed with a steel-hard tail. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Hidden Power
moves.description: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water- type moves.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.description: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the foe. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Rock Smash
moves.description: The user hits with a punch that may lower the target’s Defense. It can also smash cracked boulders.

moves.name: Whirlpool
moves.description: Traps the foe inside a whirlpool that lasts for two to five turns. The user can pass through whirlpools.

moves.name: Hail
moves.description: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except the Ice type.

moves.name: Torment
moves.description: The user torments and enrages the foe, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

moves.name: Will-O-Wisp
moves.description: The user shoots a sinister, bluish white flame at the foe to inflict a burn.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

moves.name: Focus Punch
moves.description: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. It will fail if the user is hit before it is used.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.description: The foe is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for two to four turns.

moves.name: Recycle
moves.description: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

moves.name: Brick Break
moves.description: The user attacks with tough fists, etc. It can also break any barrier such as Light Screen and Reflect.

moves.name: Skill Swap
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to exchange abilities with the foe.

moves.name: Snatch
moves.description: The user steals the effects of any healing or stat- changing move the foe attempts to use.

moves.name: Secret Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

moves.name: Overheat
moves.description: The user attacks the foe at full power. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.description: Boulders are hurled at the foe. It also lowers the foe’s Speed by preventing its movement.

moves.name: Silver Wind
moves.description: The foe is attacked with powdery scales blown by wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats.

moves.name: Bullet Seed
moves.description: The user forcefully shoots seeds at the foe. Two to five seeds are shot in rapid succession.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: The user confounds the foe with speed, then slashes. The attack lands without fail.

moves.name: Dragon Claw
moves.description: The user slashes the foe with huge, sharp claws.

moves.name: Bulk Up
moves.description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting both its Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Shock Wave
moves.description: The user strikes the foe with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack cannot be evaded.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.description: The user attacks the foe with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the foe.

moves.name: Roost
moves.description: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user’s HP by up to half of its max HP.

moves.name: Gyro Ball
moves.description: The user tackles the foe with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

moves.name: Brine
moves.description: If the foe’s HP is down to about half, this attack will hit with double the power.

moves.name: Natural Gift
moves.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

moves.name: Pluck
moves.description: The user pecks the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user plucks it and gains its effect.

moves.name: U-turn
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Payback
moves.description: If the user can use this attack after the foe attacks, its power is doubled.

moves.name: Embargo
moves.description: It prevents the foe from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.

moves.name: Fling
moves.description: The user flings its held item at the foe to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

moves.name: Rock Polish
moves.description: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It can sharply raise the Speed stat.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description: The foe is stabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped in poison. It may also poison the foe.

moves.name: Dark Pulse
moves.description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: X-Scissor
moves.description: The user slashes at the foe by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

moves.name: Dragon Pulse
moves.description: The foe is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user’s gaping mouth.

moves.name: Drain Punch
moves.description: An energy-draining punch. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Focus Blast
moves.description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the foe. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the foe using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

moves.name: Avalanche
moves.description: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.

moves.name: Shadow Claw
moves.description: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Flash Cannon
moves.description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Rock Climb
moves.description: A charging attack that may also leave the foe confused. It can also be used to scale rocky walls.

moves.name: Trick Room
moves.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

moves.name: Stone Edge
moves.description: The user stabs the foe with a sharpened stone. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Captivate
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Stealth Rock
moves.description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the foe. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.description: The user snares the foe with grass and trips it. The heavier the foe, the greater the damage.

moves.name: Charge Beam
moves.description: The user fires a concentrated bundle of electricity. It may also raise the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Fire Punch
moves.description: The foe is punched with a fiery fist. It may leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Ice Punch
moves.description: The foe is punched with an icy fist. It may leave the target frozen.

moves.name: Thunder Punch
moves.description: The foe is punched with an electrified fist. It may leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Headbutt
moves.description: The user attacks with its head. It may make the foe flinch. To find Pokémon, hit trees.

moves.name: Low Kick
moves.description: A powerful low kick that makes the foe fall over. It inflicts greater damage on heavier foes.

moves.name: String Shot
moves.description: The foe is bound with silk blown from the user’s mouth. It reduces the target’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the foe. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Sky Attack
moves.description: A second-turn attack move with a high critical-hit ratio. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Super Fang
moves.description: The user chomps hard on the foe with its sharp front fangs. It cuts the target’s HP to half.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the foe flinch.

moves.name: Spite
moves.description: The user looses its grudge on the move last used by the foe by cutting 4 PP from it.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.description: The user hurls mud in the foe’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. It also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Outrage
moves.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. However, it then becomes confused.

moves.name: Rollout
moves.description: The user continually rolls into the foe over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

moves.name: Fury Cutter
moves.description: The foe is slashed with scythes or claws. Its power increases if it hits in succession.

moves.name: Heal Bell
moves.description: The user makes a soothing bell chime to heal the status problems of all the party Pokémon.

moves.name: Pain Split
moves.description: The user adds its HP to the foe’s HP, then equally shares the combined HP with the foe.

moves.name: Synthesis
moves.description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

moves.name: Twister
moves.description: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at the foe. It may also make the foe flinch.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

moves.name: Uproar
moves.description: The user attacks in an uproar for two to five turns. Over that time, no one can fall asleep.

moves.name: Heat Wave
moves.description: The user exhales a heated breath on the foe to attack. It may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description: A move that boosts the power of the ally’s attack in a Double Battle.

moves.name: Trick
moves.description: The user catches the foe off guard and swaps the foe’s held item with its own.

moves.name: Role Play
moves.description: The user mimics the foe completely, copying the foe’s natural ability.

moves.name: Superpower
moves.description: The user attacks the foe with great power. However, it also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense.

moves.name: Magic Coat
moves.description: A barrier reflects back to the foe moves like Leech Seed and moves that damage status.

moves.name: Knock Off
moves.description: The user slaps down the foe’s held item, preventing the item from being used during the battle.

moves.name: Endeavor
moves.description: An attack move that cuts down the foe’s HP to equal the user’s HP.

moves.name: Dive
moves.description: A two-turn attack. The user dives underwater on the first turn, then hits on the next turn.

moves.name: Air Cutter
moves.description: The user launches razorlike wind to slash the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Signal Beam
moves.description: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. It may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.description: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

moves.name: Block
moves.description: The user blocks the foe’s way with arms spread wide to prevent escape.

moves.name: Bounce
moves.description: The user bounces up high, then drops on the foe on the second turn. It may also paralyze the foe.

moves.name: Gravity
moves.description: Gravity is intensified for five turns, making moves involving flying unusable and negating Levitation.

moves.name: Tailwind
moves.description: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that ups the Speed of all party Pokémon for three turns.

moves.name: Gastro Acid
moves.description: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the foe. The fluid eliminates the effect of the foe’s ability.

moves.name: Last Resort
moves.description: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

moves.name: Worry Seed
moves.description: A seed that causes worry is planted on the foe. It prevents sleep by making its ability Insomnia.

moves.name: Sucker Punch
moves.description: This move enables the user to attack first. It fails if the foe is not readying an attack, however.

moves.name: Magnet Rise
moves.description: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.

moves.name: Aqua Tail
moves.description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

moves.name: Seed Bomb
moves.description: The user slams a barrage of hard- shelled seeds down on the foe from above.

moves.name: Vacuum Wave
moves.description: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the foe. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: The user makes the ground under the foe erupt with power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and rams the foe. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Gunk Shot
moves.description: The user shoots filthy garbage at the foe to attack. It may also poison the target.

moves.name: Iron Head
moves.description: The foe slams the target with its steel-hard head. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Bug Bite
moves.description: The user bites the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

moves.name: Ominous Wind
moves.description: The user creates a gust of repulsive wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.
